fields.text: Turn an anime character drawing into a realistic cosplay photo. Muse paints an original anime character. Gemini 3.8 Flash looks at that picture and writes a feature list (hair, eyes, outfit, props, pose, background) plus a photo prompt for an invented adult cosplayer wearing the outfit as a real costume. Muse renders that prompt as a photo, from the text alone, so nothing is traced from the drawing. Swap the Anime art Image for a 📷 Image input to read your own original character (no real people or existing IP). Inspired by @SuskyH99882's Anime → Realistic Cosplay ComfyUI workflow (https://x.com/SuskyH99882/status/2116568710563717316).

Original anime character illustration, an invented character (not from any existing anime, manga or game). A young adult woman, about 25, standing in a three-quarter pose on a rainy city rooftop at dusk. Long straight teal hair with blunt bangs and one thin braid on the left side tied with a small brass ring; amber eyes. She wears a cropped cobalt-blue bomber jacket with a wide white stripe across each sleeve and an orange quilted lining, over a black high-neck top, high-waisted charcoal cargo trousers with knee pads and white high-top sneakers. Fully clothed. She holds a closed clear vinyl umbrella with a bright orange handle resting on her shoulder, and a small round brass pocket-watch charm hangs from her belt loop. Confident small smile. Clean cel-shaded anime style, crisp line art, soft rim light, full body visible from head to sneakers. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no signature.

fields.prompt: Read this anime character and write the cosplay photo prompt.
fields.system: You turn an anime character illustration into the brief for a realistic cosplay photo. Look at the attached image itself; describe only what is visible. Write two parts. FEATURES: one short line each for hair (colour, length, cut, braids or accessories), eyes, face and expression, outfit top to bottom (each garment with its exact colours, stripes, linings, trims), props and accessories, pose, and background. PHOTO PROMPT: one paragraph describing a realistic full-body photo of an invented adult cosplayer (a real-looking person, not a known person or actor) wearing this exact outfit as a well-made physical costume with real fabrics, holding the same props, in the same pose and a matching real-world location and light. Keep every colour, stripe and prop faithful; turn drawn details into real materials (nylon, quilted lining, cotton, canvas, vinyl, brushed brass) and a styled wig. Fully clothed, natural skin texture, DSLR photo, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. No anime style, no line art, no text, no logos. Do not name any anime, artist, studio or real person. Return only the two parts, under 260 words.
